# Copyright check exclude patterns (one regex per line; lines starting with # are comments).
# Shared by check_copyright.py and add_copyright_headers.py.
#
# Usage:
#   python3 .github/workflows/scripts/check_copyright.py . \
#     --exclude-config .github/workflows/scripts/copyright_excludes.txt
#
# Bundles, downloaded models, and local run/output dirs are gitignored and not
# project-authored, so they must never be headered or checked.
skills/.*/bundle/
skills/.*/bundles/
\.workbench_data/
runs/
__pycache__/
\.pytest_cache/
# Private working notes (gitignored).
discussions/

# Local virtualenvs / vendored site-packages (never project-authored).
\.venv/
venv/
site-packages/
node_modules/
\.tox/

# request-nvskills-ci.yml is owned/validated by the NVSkills CI integration; leave it unheadered.
\.github/workflows/request-nvskills-ci\.yml

# Bot-generated NVSkills signing artifacts (committed by svc-nvskills-signing).
(^|/)skill-card\.md$
(^|/)BENCHMARK\.md$
(^|/)skill\.oms\.sig$

# completeness verifier can grade them. Headering them makes NVCARPS detect-changes treat
# them as nested resource roots (disallowed). Mirrors eval_engine/manifest.py.
verifiers/skill_completeness_v1/fixtures/
